name: offer-billing-off
about: A personal account on a node with billing off: billingOff, no free month or card gate, freeSandboxes in all and how many are left, the limits on each (freeLimits), and expect in plain words.

response.expect: Billing is off on this node, so no card is taken and nothing is charged: 5 free sandboxes in all, each up to 15 min, 1 vCPU, 2 GiB memory, 1 at a time. After that, new sandboxes are refused.
